Best,

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the MAP — customer milestones are standard: setup (wk1), integration + eval (wk1–3), performance signoff (wk4–6). If they commit to the 12-month reserved pool at the end of the evaluation we can offer a structured milestone rebate rather than a single large up-front discount. Suggestion: 7% off list if they sign at commit + an additional 3% rebate paid after the 30-day performance signoff (so effective max 10% if all milestones hit).

Aditya — please advise finance tolerance; if not acceptable I can propose a smaller upfront discount + larger performance rebate.

Appreciate the framing. From a finance policy perspective: we can approve up to 5% as a delegated discount for Strategic ARR opportunities. Anything above 5% requires CFO sign-off (I can route). For tiered rebates tied to objective milestones I want the payout mechanics codified in the SOW (clear dates, metrics, & cap). Also request we model blended unit economics at 0.8 cents/token post-discount to ensure we hit contribution targets.

If you push for 7% up-front + 3% on performance, I'll need an exec email to the CFO that documents the rationale and the ARR uplift case. I can prepare the finance memo if you want.

Aditya
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference

Emily — thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. To summarize our proposed commercial path:
- Pilot & eval (July 5 start) — standard hosted pricing
- If TidalWare signs the 12-month reserved pool at the end of the eval: 7% off list at commit + a 3% performance rebate after 30-day signoff (total potential 10% if milestones met).
- PS will be quoted separately in the SOW.

Per finance policy, the 7% upfront discount is an exception. Aditya will take the finance memo to the CFO, but to speed things up could you confirm the expected committed tokens/day and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly invoicing)? That will help our ARR uplift write-up.

Attaching the MAP and SOW draft for reference.

Thanks —
Jordan
